candidate.source_tree_hash_contract: SHA-256 over every non-target regular file below the named module, sorted by repository-relative path, with each path and byte payload prefixed by its unsigned eight-byte big-endian length

existing_shared_boundaries_retained: reframe4s-resample owns Flashalign's fused sparse value-and-gradient sampler
reframe4s-multiscale owns Flashalign's support-aware physical pyramid
canonical AffineMap and FramedAffine types carry the Flashalign-to-HalfFlow handoff
the unpublished CrossMethodEvidenceRunner owns orchestration across both methods
decision.reason: No candidate matched support and mask rules, interpolation and derivative semantics, physical scale policy, and cache identity at two concrete call sites. An extraction would change a method objective, add a dependency for incompatible behavior, or duplicate an existing canonical boundary.

semantic_findings.sampling: Flashalign samples sparse world points with complete eight-tap support and analytic trilinear world gradients; HalfFlow pulls dense scalar lattices and computes mask-aware physical finite differences after warping, while BasinBridge uses voxel-window scalar sampling.
semantic_findings.pyramid: Flashalign subtracts an affine-derived source PSF from target PSFs and propagates fractional zero-padded support directly from native data; HalfFlow applies its frozen shrink/sigma schedule with separable axis kernels, binary validity, partial-linear support and a different minimum weight.
semantic_findings.affine: The existing fromMovingToFixed adapter already accepts the canonical map and performs the required inversion exactly once; another wrapper would obscure direction semantics.
semantic_findings.indexing: Flashalign's exact point registry is keyed by an immutable sample set and physical stencil with draw multiplicity; HalfFlow uses dense box sums or per-anchor search windows with unrelated cache lifetimes.
semantic_findings.evidence: The benchmark runner already shares loading, map composition, independent metrics, lane cost and complete failure denominators while retaining method-specific diagnostics.

maintenance_and_cost.dependency_effect: HalfFlow presently has no reframe4s-resample or reframe4s-multiscale dependency. Adding one without exact semantic reuse would enlarge the graph and require representation adapters.
maintenance_and_cost.timing_boundary: No timing result can admit substitution of a numerically different kernel. Flashalign's existing projected-patch allocation probe remains 24 bytes at 2000 and 20000 iterations; HalfFlow retains its separately frozen dense-stage cost evidence.

validation.command: sbt -J-Xmx4G -Dsbt.supershell=false with focused LinearValueGradientSampler3Suite, SparseValueGradientBuffer3Suite, SupportAwarePyramid3Suite, SuppliedAffineAdapterSuite, BasinBridgeBlockMatcherSuite, HalfFlowCcEngineSuite and CrossMethodEvidenceSuite targets
validation.repository_checks: Build graph 28 nodes and 95 edges; symbol ownership 1407 public qualified names and 66 owners; PRD 148 IDs, 28 nodes and 95 edges, acyclic; git diff --check clean.

reopen_trigger: Reconsider sharing only when two consumers need an exact existing contract without compatibility switches and parity plus measured allocation or compute benefit are available before migration.
claim_boundary: This receipt supports a no-additional-extraction decision for the audited candidate families. It does not claim the implementations are mathematically interchangeable, qualify Flashalign accuracy, admit Flashalign-to-HalfFlow transfer, or preclude a future proposal with two newly equivalent call sites.
